title: Sugar taste neurons (LB3b, LB3c) at 100 Hz, 0.5-1.5 s

expect.text: MN9 fires and the proboscis extends while the sugar neurons are active.
expect.source: Shiu et al. 2024 Nature (sugar GRN activation drives MN9, Fig 2); MN9 drives the rostrum protractor (McKellar et al. 2020)
expect.status: development evidence: sugar->MN9 at 100 Hz is in the model's fit set (docs/HANDOFF.md register), not a held-out test

criterion.what: mean MN9 rate during the stimulus minus the control's (the proboscis movement itself is not scored)
criterion.basis: guessed threshold, written 4 October 2026 before any library result was viewed

config_history: 4 Oct 2026, after the first library was viewed: override motor_unit:all|force_per_spike = 10 removed (copied from docs/RUNNING.md examples, not part of m9), so the library runs the adopted m9 profile as the model owner fits it. The first library (runs/app/lib) was recorded with it.
